Kit summary

Ghost InvasionBasic
Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single enemy and 2 random enemies, with a 50% chance to reduce the target's DEF by 30% for 2 turns, then restores self HP by 2.5% of Max HP for each target’s DEF successfully reduced by this skill.
Binding TerrorActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 120% ATK DMG to all enemies and increases their duration of all attribute debuffs by 1 turn, then restores self HP by 14% of Max HP. The restoration effect increases by 15% for every enemy target that has a debuff.
Soulbinding Scroll Lv.1Binding Terror: Inflict [Horrify] on targets who have no attribute buffs for 1 turn.
Death EnergyPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Gerina restores self HP by 14% of Max HP when a target dies.
Soulbinding Scroll Lv.2Gerina restores self HP by 25% of Max HP and increases her Turn Meter by 25% whenever an enemy target is revived.
Evil RebornActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants all allies [Immortal] for 1 turn and [Heal] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, Gerina deducts self HP by 8% of Max HP whenever an ally dies to revive this ally with 40% of Max HP. Gerina's HP will not be deducted to revive an ally if her HP is too low.
Soulbinding Scroll Lv.3Evil Reborn: Increases the Turn Meters of revived allies by 30% and grants them [Stealth] for 1 turn.
